description:
Found on 2026-11-11 while delivering retro-navigation-fixes-umbrella-20261111 (or in the retrospective over 25 agent sessions that preceded it) and not addressed there.

Problem. `_project/scripts/soundness_merge_digest.py --since <sha>` fails with `fatal: path '.github/soundness-paths.txt' exists on disk, but not in '<sha>~1'` for any commit before 6ab697f91c (2026-09-29), where the manifest was added. Four reviewed sessions each rediscovered that floor. A six-week window makes several thousand GitHub API calls and takes 15 to 25 minutes, and a single API error (TLS handshake timeouts were seen) ends the run with exit 2 and no partial output, so four sessions spent over two hours without one completed dry run. docs/internal/merge-queue-governance.md documents the command with no floor, runtime or failure mode. A tracker acceptance asked for a 90-day dry run when only about 42 days of manifest history existed.

Change. Document the floor and runtime beside the command; retry a failed API call a bounded number of times.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone, and pass absolute worktree paths to every file tool; stage paths explicitly; no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check); heavy work only via make heavy-run, never forcing admission; never bypass a required check, ruleset, hold label or review gate; re-read every cited file on current origin/develop first, because line numbers and commits here are from 2026-11-11 (origin/develop 5bd2c19cc4); close at a merged PR and finish only after the merge is observed.
